description: This file defines the Products class for the vtiger CRM system, including properties and methods for managing product data, relations with other modules, saving/updating details, and generating export queries.

classes.name: Products
classes.description: The Products class extends CRMEntity, providing methods for managing product records, including CRUD operations, relations with other modules, export functionality, and dependency management within vtiger CRM.

methods.name: Products
methods.description: Constructor initializes dependencies like logger, database, and column fields for the product entity.

methods.name: save_module
methods.description: Handles saving related tax and pricing information, as well as attachments, when a product is saved.

methods.name: insertTaxInformation
methods.description: Inserts or updates tax relationship data for a product into vtiger_producttaxrel based on selected taxes.

methods.name: insertPriceInformation
methods.description: Inserts or updates currency and price relationship data for a product into vtiger_productcurrencyrel.

methods.name: updateUnitPrice
methods.description: Updates the actual price of the product in the currency relation based on the current unit price.

methods.name: insertIntoAttachment
methods.description: Handles file uploads and associations with the product record.

methods.name: get_leads
methods.description: Retrieves leads associated with the product.

methods.name: get_accounts
methods.description: Retrieves accounts associated with the product.

methods.name: get_contacts
methods.description: Retrieves contacts associated with the product.

methods.name: get_opportunities
methods.description: Retrieves sales opportunities related to the product.

methods.name: get_tickets
methods.description: Retrieves tickets related to the product.

methods.name: get_activities
methods.description: Lists activities linked with the product, such as calendar events.

methods.name: get_quotes
methods.description: Fetches quotes associated with the product.

methods.name: get_purchase_orders
methods.description: Retrieves purchase orders related to the product.

methods.name: get_salesorder
methods.description: Obtains sales orders linked with the product.

methods.name: get_invoices
methods.description: Gathers invoicing records related to the product.

methods.name: get_product_pricebooks
methods.description: Lists price books that include the product.

methods.name: product_novendor
methods.description: Counts products that do not have a linked vendor.

methods.name: get_products
methods.description: Retrieves products related to a given product.

methods.name: get_parent_products
methods.description: Gets parent products of the current product.

methods.name: create_export_query
methods.description: Generates SQL query for exporting product data based on filters.

methods.name: isparent_check
methods.description: Checks if the product is a parent product of others.

methods.name: ismember_check
methods.description: Checks if the product is a member (child) of other products.

methods.name: transferRelatedRecords
methods.description: Transfers related records from one product to another.

methods.name: generateReportsSecQuery
methods.description: Constructs secondary report query related to products.

methods.name: setRelationTables
methods.description: Provides relation table info for linked modules.

methods.name: deleteProduct2ProductRelation
methods.description: Removes product-to-product relationship depending on whether the product is parent or not.

methods.name: unlinkDependencies
methods.description: Unlinks related dependencies, e.g., campaigns related to a product.

methods.name: unlinkRelationship
methods.description: Removes specific relationship between this product and another module record.

methods.name: save_related_module
methods.description: Saves relating modules with the product record.
